description: Land Acquisition - Arandara, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District and 3 other notices in Colombo & Hambanthota Districts
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders for taking possession of specific land parcels, detailed descriptions of land boundaries and extents, and one revocation of a previous land acquisition order. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other non-land matters.
